qualityBoundary: These are isolated capital and flourish studies. No full lowercase words or names are displayed; the source phrases identify their location in the reference photo only.
reconstructionNotes: Paper colour, texture, stains, compression grain, browser interface, and unrelated words are omitted.
Capital centerlines follow source ink and are fitted to smooth curves at a standardized 0.72 native-pixel hairline.
Broad pressure strokes use selected original ink components; lowercase pressure fragments are excluded.
The H upper return is locally fitted through source anchors where a lowercase ascender crosses it.
The terminal flourish is separated from its lowercase joining stroke and tapered at the separation for a clean study.
These are source-based study redraws, not facsimiles and not independent evidence of an exact measured slant.
